description: Defines custom exception classes for application error handling, including AppException and specific subclasses like UnauthorizedException, ServerException, NotFoundException, and BadRequestException.

classes.name: AppException
classes.description: Base exception class implementing Dart's Exception, with a message field.

classes.name: UnauthorizedException
classes.description: Represents an unauthorized error, extending AppException.

classes.name: NotFoundException
classes.description: Represents not found errors, extending AppException.

classes.name: BadRequestException
classes.description: Represents bad request errors, extending AppException.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Overrides Object's toString to return the error message.
